model.derivation: KV: src/llama-model.cpp:2836-2855 (full layout on CUDA, docs/olala-setup.md:223) gives 7 x 2 x 12 x 128 x 2 B = 43,008 B per token (1,344 MiB at 32,768, matches docs/olala-setup.md:206). Recurrent: src/llama-hparams.cpp:232 and 278-281 with ssm_inner 3072, dt_rank 64, d_state 128, mimo 4: n_embd_r 3,072 + n_embd_s 431,616 floats, allocated for all 36 layers (src/llama-model.cpp:2790, src/llama-memory-recurrent.cpp:101-103) in f32. The overhead (compute buffers and CUDA context) is an ASSUMPTION, not measured.
